_comment: Generated for Pterodactyl Panel. The installer downloads the interactive setup script.
name: EaglerXServer Standalone
author: EaglerXServer contributors

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server
chmod -R a+rwX /mnt/server
printf '%s\n' 'The server directory is writable; setup.sh will be fetched to /tmp at startup.'
